Procedural Grass

Climate changes re-resolve the current genome live (and drive COLOR: fertility→greener, aridity/heat→gold/straw, cold+light→red/purple, aridity+sun→blue-grey wax). Star temp: 0.55=Sun (green); cooler→darker/red, hotter→yellower. Hit Generate to adapt a new specimen.
Tiller count: 0=1 blade, 1≈12 blades. Clump spread: 0=single point, 1=wide ring. Fan spread: 0=all parallel, 1=full azimuthal fan. Seed head: 0=none, 1=full head. Inflorescence: 0=none, low=open panicle, high=tight wheat spike. Spikelet count / Grains / Awn length / Mid-ear bulge shape the ear (need Seed head > 0 & Inflorescence > 0).
Length / Width / Taper are MIN–MAX ranges (two sliders): each blade in the clump samples its own value between them → varied tillers. Length: 0=0.15 m, 1=2.2 m. Width: 0=narrow, 1=broad. Taper: 0=parallel-sided, 1=sharp acuminate tip. Blade shape: 0=straight taper, 1=lanceolate belly. Cross-section curl: 0=flat, 1=deep channel. Blade twist: 0=straight, 1=corkscrew. Stem roundness: 0=flat blade, 1=round stalk (reeds/rushes).
Arch & Tip droop are MIN–MAX ranges (per-blade variation). Arch: 0=stiff upright, 1=strong droop cascade. Tip droop: extra droop in the distal third. Curve: in-plane lateral S/C arc. Verticality: 0=prostrate, 0.5=erect, 1=pendulous. Stiffness: 1=rigid, 0=floppy.
Condition-driven color: Hue = species base (green band). Chlorophyll = green darkness. Senescence = green→gold→straw. Antho propensity = how readily it reddens under cold+light. Glaucousness = waxy blue-grey. (Climate sliders also push these — see Climate tab.) Color variation = per-blade spread. Veining = striations + drying tips.
